prompt: Create a creative double-exposure watercolor portrait composition on a vertical 2:3 canvas with a clean off-white paper background. The subject is a young South Asian woman with warm light-brown skin, dark expressive eyes, soft red lips, and black hair in a loose messy high bun with wispy strands framing her face. Show two integrated views of the same woman: one full-body seated figure in the lower left foreground and one oversized semi-transparent bust portrait occupying the upper right background. The seated woman rests gracefully on weathered stone steps, wearing a flowing sheer white lace maxi dress with long sleeves, delicate embroidery, layered ruffles, and white flat sandals; she sits with one knee forward, one hand resting on her knee, and her other elbow propped with her chin on her hand, gazing calmly to the side. Add subtle jewelry: dangling pearl earrings and a small pearl pendant necklace. Behind her, blend the large portrait into soft watercolor washes of muted olive green foliage, beige stone tones, gray-brown splatters, and translucent ink blooms, with visible paint drips running downward on the right side. Include a small terracotta flower pot filled with tiny white and pink blossoms on the stone step to her left. Use a refined fashion-illustration watercolor style: realistic facial features, delicate skin shading, crisp eyes and lips, translucent fabric texture, loose edges, granulating pigments, splashes, speckles, and layered wash effects. Keep the palette soft ivory, warm beige, muted olive green, charcoal brown, blush pink, and deep black hair. No text, no border, no watermark, elegant airy composition with high detail in the face and dress and painterly abstraction around the edges.

promptZh: 在 2:3 的竖版画布上创作一幅富有创意的双重曝光水彩肖像，背景为干净的米白色纸张质感。主体为 一位年轻的南亚女性，拥有温暖的浅棕色皮肤、深邃传神的眼睛、柔和的红唇，黑色头发梳成凌乱的高发髻，几缕发丝垂在脸颊旁。画面展示同一女性的两个融合视角：左下方前景为全身坐姿，右上方背景为巨大的半透明半身肖像。坐着的女性优雅地倚靠在风化的石阶上，身穿 一件飘逸的半透明白色蕾丝长裙，带有长袖、精致刺绣、层叠荷叶边，脚穿白色平底凉鞋；她单膝前屈，一只手放在膝盖上，另一只手撑着下巴，神情平静地看向侧方。佩戴精致首饰：垂坠珍珠耳环和一条小巧的珍珠吊坠项链。在她身后，将巨大的肖像与柔和的水彩渲染融合，色调包括柔和的橄榄绿叶片、米色石材色、灰棕色喷溅以及半透明的墨色晕染，右侧可见明显的颜料滴落效果。包含 左侧石阶上放着一个小陶土花盆，里面种着细小的粉白色花朵。采用精致的时装插画水彩风格：写实的五官、细腻的皮肤阴影、清晰的眼唇刻画、半透明的织物纹理、松散的边缘、颗粒感颜料、喷溅、斑点及层叠的渲染效果。色调保持 柔和象牙白、暖米色、柔和橄榄绿、炭棕色、腮红粉以及深黑色头发。无文字、无边框、无水印，构图优雅通透，面部与服饰细节丰富，边缘呈现水彩画的抽象美感。
